title: Playground
subtitle: Chat through the gateway using a configured model alias.
emptyHint: Uses a session-backed stream against the selected alias.
emptySetup: {gap, select, provider {Connect a <providers>provider</providers> first.} other {Add one under <models>Models</models>.}}
emptySetupAction: {gap, select, provider {Connect a provider} other {Add a model}}
toolsHint: Optional JSON array sent as tools. Leave empty to omit.
toolsError: Tools JSON must be a JSON array.
storageError: Could not save sessions in this browser.
systemHint: Optional instructions sent as the first system message. Leave empty to omit.
replayLoaded: Loaded request {id}, originally sent to {model}. Check the prompt and model, then send.
replayDropped: Tool calls, tool results, and attachments that the Playground cannot send were left out.
replayTruncated: Long values were shortened when the request was logged, so the replay can differ.
replayMasked: Personal data was masked in the stored prompt. The placeholders are sent as they are.
